evidence.quote: The uptick in the unemployment rate relative to the start of the year suggests that demand has fallen by a bit more than supply and that the downside risks to employment are rising.
I see the risks to employment as tilted to the downside and risks to inflation to the upside.
As such, I expect the disinflation process to resume after this year and inflation to return to the 2 percent target in the coming years.
trends across several data series indicate that the labor market is softening, which suggests that, left unsupported, it could experience stress.
I will continue to evaluate the appropriate stance of monetary policy based on the incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks.
